cohort: The study included 223 pregnant women with normal fetuses, who were obese or non-obese pre-pregnancy, with underweight women excluded.
finding: Maternal obesity was associated with Caesarean section, with an increased risk in obese mothers compared to non-obese mothers.
mod_finding: Maternal obesity was associated with an increased risk of Caesarean section (RR 2.398 CI 1.328-4.329).
